title: Motus commitment envelope v1
description: One BEGIN or END as it is stored in a window file or handed to another party. The acknowledgement sits BESIDE the digested body and never inside it: a leaf digest cannot depend on a value that did not exist when the witness signed it. The store declares its format once in identity.json (motus-commitlog/1), so this document carries no version of its own; a receipt, which travels alone, does.

witness.description: Absent or null when no witness acknowledged this commitment. ADR-021: an unreachable witness downgrades the assurance mode and never blocks the run, so its absence is an ordinary outcome and not a defect.

Digest.description: A digest names its algorithm or it is refused. A bare 64-hex string leaves a verifier in 2034 guessing which function to recompute.

BundleFingerprint.description: What TraceBundle.fingerprint produces, over bundle_version, the complete graph_spec and the trace — not over the trace alone.

Identifier.description: Opaque to Motus (ADR-021 decision 6), and non-blank: three spaces name nothing.

Continuation.description: What a resumed segment's BEGIN says about the segment it continues (ADR-023). writer_id and sequence appear together or not at all: run_id cannot name a predecessor, because a run_id may repeat and a BEGIN carries no digest of its own segment. Their absence records a predecessor in a chain this store does not hold — unresolved from here, which is neither a confirmation nor a denial.

WitnessAck.description: An independent party stating it already held this commitment. `commitment` is the LEAF digest of what was acknowledged: an acknowledgement that does not name what it acknowledges is decoration.

sequence.description: Per WRITER, and it does not restart at a window boundary (ADR-021 decision 5). This is what names an execution when a run_id repeats.

run_id.description: NOT unique. A retried job keeping its id is the ordinary case.

root.description: The derived root of the evidence this run produced (ADR-019). END only: a BEGIN precedes the outcome and cannot carry one.

then.description: A BEGIN precedes the outcome and cannot carry one.
An END binds an outcome to the evidence that produced it, so it carries both; and it cannot continue anything, because a segment is continued at the moment it starts.
